admission.justification: The start refusal, the lifecycle refusals, the cleanup refusal and the abandon way-out each cover only their own routes; only together do they promise that every reachable route refuses and exactly one escape restarts the work.

guarantee: Every route that creates, lands, judges or closes a task carrying the removed mode refuses it by the same name with the same reason and the known way out: the start refuses before anything is created, the lifecycle routes refuse instead of judging nothing, cleanup of a terminal archive refuses without a developer decision — while status and read routes keep answering, modeless attach to a live existing leaf stays available, and abandon plus a modeless restart is the documented escape — so no disabled task strands mid-flight and no route lands one silently.
title: Named refusal with the known way out at every disabled route
